q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

answer:
Net sales fell from ₹645,654 last week to ₹182,618 this week (measured), driven mainly by much lower orders and lower ad spend; the data shows associations (traffic & spend moved with sales) but does not prove a single causal edit. 

Evidence (measured — order-date unless noted)
- Last week (2026-10-05→2026-10-11): Net sales ₹645,654 · Orders 339 · Ad spend ₹430,736 · Net profit −₹68,271 · Net ROAS 0.8415  
- This week (2026-10-12→2026-10-14, partial day): Net sales ₹182,618 · Orders 97 · Ad spend ₹121,390 · Net profit −₹4,937 · Net ROAS 0.9593

Why it changed (from the diagnostic decomposition — what moved, and how confident we are)
- Biggest measured movers (exact arithmetic split / verified): Orders drop is the primary lever — orders fell from 339 → 97 (large negative effect on sales). Measured.  
- Traffic fell: Sessions and page events decreased substantially (sessions fell in the diagnostic window and explain most of the orders drop). Measured; the causal engine labels this as an association (moved together) not a supported single cause.  
- Ad spend fell (measured): spend declined (₹430.7k → ₹121.4k) and moved together with sales; the diagnostic tests find correlation but insufficient evidence to call it a proven cause.  
- Mix & conversion shifts: conversion rates and channel/campaign mix changed (some campaigns went to zero); the diagnosis shows Simpson-like mix effects and specific campaigns (e.g., TH-383 campaign) that went from revenue to zero — these are concrete places to inspect. Measured for the mix shift; campaign-level drops are shown but labelled as candidates, not proven root causes.  
- Returns/discounts were not the main driver: the decomposition attributes most of the sales change to lower gross sales / product net sales, not refunds or discounts. Measured.

Confidence and caveats
- The diagnostic found notable changes but did not identify a single supported_cause — most upstream items passed causal checks as correlations or had insufficient evidence. The week ending 2026-10-14 is partial (today is in-progress) so the this-week totals include 2026-10-14 partial data. Data as of 2026-10-14.  
- Key concrete findings to act on: large drop in orders & sessions, large reduction in ad spend, and several campaigns/ads that dropped to zero revenue.
